messages:
Adrian (Design): Drafting copy for the modal when someone tries to delete an evaluation suite. It can be used by dashboards so we need to surface risk and link to dependents. Posting 3 options below.

Priya (Product): Thanks — paste the options please. Also note legal wants 'irreversible' phrasing where appropriate.

Adrian (Design): Option A (concise, direct):

  "Delete evaluation suite?"
  "This action permanently deletes the evaluation suite and its results. Dashboards that depend on this suite will stop receiving new regressions. This cannot be undone."
  Buttons: [Cancel] [Delete]

Option B (friendlier):

  "Remove evaluation suite"
  "Removing this suite deletes stored results and stops any scheduled checks. You can recreate the suite, but history will be lost."
  Buttons: [Keep it] [Remove suite]

Option C (explicit, links):

  "Delete evaluation suite and results"
  "This permanently removes the suite and its results. The following dashboards reference this suite: [View dependents]. Deletion cannot be undone."
  Buttons: [Cancel] [Delete and remove results]

Jon (Eng): I like A for clarity but +1 to listing dependents like C. Also flag: if there are active alerts linked to the suite we should surface that.

Marta (Design): Tone nit — 'Delete' is scary, but accurate. If we go with A, consider changing secondary button label to a more explicit action label: `Delete evaluation suite` instead of just `Delete`. Accessibility: ensure modal heading is H2, focus trap, and use aria-describedby for the explanatory line.

design-bot: Reminder: our modal button pattern is sentence case and primary button shows danger style for destructive actions.

Adrian (Design): Proposed final copy (merge A + C):

  Heading: "Delete evaluation suite"
  Body: "This action permanently deletes the evaluation suite and all stored results. Dashboards and alerts that reference this suite will stop receiving updates. This cannot be undone.

  [View dependent dashboards]"
  Buttons: [Cancel] [Delete evaluation suite]

Priya (Product): Love this. Can we make the dependent link open the dependency panel and also show a small inline count (e.g., "View dependent dashboards (2)")?

Jon (Eng): Yup, we can: add a route to /evals/:id/dependents and we can include the count. Also will surface active alerts in the UI ("2 dashboards, 1 active alert").

Marta (Design): Accessibility check: add `aria-describedby` pointing to the body copy, ensure the link has clear text (not just "View"), and confirm keyboard focus lands on the Cancel button first per pattern.

Adrian (Design): Finalized copy to handoff to PM/Eng and Legal:

  Heading: "Delete evaluation suite"
  Body (aria-describedby): "This action permanently deletes the evaluation suite and all stored results. Dashboards and alerts that reference this suite will stop receiving updates. This cannot be undone."
  Link: "View dependent dashboards (2)"
  Buttons: [Cancel] [Delete evaluation suite]

Priya (Product): Approved. I'll create the ticket and tag @Jon for implementation and @Legal for sign-off. :white_check_mark:

Jon (Eng): I'll pick this up — will include dependent list and alert count, plus confirm keyboard focus and aria attributes in the PR.

Adrian (Design): Thanks all — filing a small copy follow-up for translations (i18n) and tooltip variant for the inline dependency list. :sparkles:
